summary.title: Quantitative System Performance
summary.one_liner: A 1984 textbook, freely available online from the authors, that teaches analytic performance modelling of computer systems using queueing network models.
keywords: how to model computer system performance
takeaways: The book is a complete reference on analytic modelling of computer systems using queueing networks.
Its chapters cover preliminaries, general analytic techniques, representing specific subsystems, parameterization, and perspective.
The full text is available online as PDF files, and a table of contents is linked from the page.
The listing notes it as the origin of the bound-and-bottleneck analysis and asymptotic throughput bounds.
summary.summary: This is the home page for the 1984 Prentice-Hall book "Quantitative System Performance: Computer System Analysis Using Queueing Network Models," which the authors have made freely available. The page links to a hyperlinked table of contents, PDF versions of the chapters, and a downloadable zip of the full text. The contents are split into Preface, Preliminaries, General Analytic Techniques, Representing Specific Subsystems, Parameterization, Perspective, Appendices, and an Index. The page itself contains little technical detail; the substance is in the book.
